title: Fixture 5
body:
## Code Changes

- `team` mapping: the identifier is `(.databaseId // .id) | tostring`, the same numeric team id in every payload shape; the `parentTeam` mapping keys on `.id` and keeps resolving, so both mappings key the same teams by the same identifier today.
- Drop the unused onboarding action.

nodes.body: **Older buyers get wrong badges** recordClubBulk reads buyers only from buyerID, even when the buyer read switch is off. If older purchases still have a null buyerID, this query misses those buyers. The existing purchase reader uses userID until those rows are backfilled, so a member who bought earlier gets a club unread row and the bought set shows NEW on the club tab instead of purchased.
Not an issue, the buyerID backfill is complete and the read switch is on.

commit.messageHeadline: Read buyers from the mirror column
